figures.ask_en: What is this gel, and what exactly does it prove?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼膠？它到底證明了什麼？
figures.a_en: 19 September 2026, the strongest cloning evidence we have. Three independent ACDI clones, X1, X3 and X9, each screened across three internal junctions: junction A at 375 bp, junction B at 632 bp, junction C at 661 bp. Nine correct junctions say the four modules are joined in the right order in three separate clones. They say nothing about the sequence between the junctions, which is why we do not claim a verified sequence from this gel alone.
figures.a_zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日，我們手上最強的選殖證據。三個獨立的 ACDI 選殖株 X1、X3、X9，各自檢查三個內部接點：接點 A 375 bp、接點 B 632 bp、接點 C 661 bp。九個正確的接點說明四個模組在三個獨立選殖株裡都以正確順序接上了。它們對接點之間的序列什麼都沒說——所以我們不會光憑這張膠就宣稱序列已經驗證。
kw_zh: 三個選殖株乘三個接點
figures.q_en: What do the nine lanes on this gel establish?
figures.q_zh: 這張膠上的九道電泳帶確立了什麼？
opt_en: That four modules are joined in the right order in three independent clones, across three junctions each
That the whole Level 2 plasmid has been sequence-verified end to end
That the construct expresses ACC deaminase in B. subtilis
That nine separate colonies carry nine different constructs
opt_zh: 四個模組在三個獨立選殖株中都以正確順序接上，每株各查三個接點
整個 Level 2 質體已從頭到尾完成定序驗證
這個構築能在 B. subtilis 中表現 ACC 去胺酶
九個獨立菌落帶的是九種不同的構築
figures.trap_en: Upgrading junction PCR to sequence verification. Junctions prove order, not content.
figures.trap_zh: 把接點 PCR 升格成定序驗證。接點證明的是順序，不是內容。

figures.ask_en: What experiment is this, and what are the two band sizes?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼實驗？兩種條帶大小各是多少？
figures.a_en: A restriction digest of the Level 2 construct from two independent clones. EcoRI alone, in lanes 1 and 3, linearises the plasmid at the expected 10,293 bp. EcoRI together with BtsI, in lanes 2 and 4, gives the expected 7,543 bp fragment. Lane 5 is the 10 kb ladder. This is an orthogonal check on the junction PCR: a different enzyme, a different prediction, the same construct.
figures.a_zh: 這是把 Level 2 構築從兩個獨立選殖株取出做的限制酶切。第 1、3 道只用 EcoRI，把質體切成線狀，落在預期的 10,293 bp。第 2、4 道用 EcoRI 加 BtsI，切出預期的 7,543 bp 片段。第 5 道是 10 kb 階梯。這是對接點 PCR 的正交驗證：不同的酵素、不同的預測、同一個構築。
kw_zh: EcoRI 切成 10,293 bp 線狀
EcoRI 加 BtsI 得 7,543 bp
figures.q_en: What does EcoRI alone do to the Level 2 plasmid here?
figures.q_zh: 在這裡，只用 EcoRI 會對 Level 2 質體做什麼？
opt_en: Linearise it at the expected 10,293 bp
Cut out the 7,543 bp insert
Leave it uncut, as a negative control
Cut it into three fragments of equal size
opt_zh: 把它切成線狀，落在預期的 10,293 bp
切出 7,543 bp 的插入片段
完全不切，當作陰性對照
切成三段等長的片段
figures.trap_en: Forgetting why a digest matters alongside the PCR. It tests the whole plasmid length, which junction primers never see.
figures.trap_zh: 忘了為什麼有了 PCR 還要做酶切。酶切檢查的是整段質體長度，那是接點引子看不到的。

figures.ask_en: What variable is being swept here, and which setting was carried forward?
figures.ask_zh: 這裡在掃描什麼變因？最後採用的是哪一個設定？
figures.a_en: 28 August 2026, the insert-to-vector ratio sweep for the Level 2 Golden Gate assembly, verified with primers specific to each module. Lanes 1 to 3 are 1:5, lanes 4 to 6 are 1:7, each labelled with its expected size of 375, 632 or 661 bp. Both ratios gave all three junctions; 1:7 was the one carried forward.
figures.a_zh: 2026 年 8 月 20 日那一週，8 月 28 日做的 Level 2 Golden Gate 組裝插入片段對載體比例掃描，用各模組專一的引子驗證。第 1 到 3 道是 1:5，第 4 到 6 道是 1:7，每一道都標了自己的預期大小 375、632 或 661 bp。兩種比例都跑出三個接點；最後帶著往下做的是 1:7。
figures.q_en: What is being compared between lanes 1-3 and lanes 4-6?
figures.q_zh: 第 1 到 3 道與第 4 到 6 道之間在比較什麼？
opt_en: Two insert-to-vector ratios in the Golden Gate assembly, 1:5 against 1:7
Two annealing temperatures in the colony PCR
Two electroporation voltages for the transformation
Two different restriction enzymes used for the digest
opt_zh: Golden Gate 組裝中兩種插入片段對載體的比例：1:5 對 1:7
菌落 PCR 的兩種黏合溫度
轉形時的兩種電穿孔電壓
酶切使用的兩種不同限制酶
figures.trap_en: Saying 1:7 was better. Both worked; 1:7 was the one we carried on with, which is a choice, not a result.
figures.trap_zh: 說 1:7 比較好。兩種都成功；1:7 只是我們選擇往下做的那一個，那是決定，不是結果。

figures.ask_en: A judge points at this gel and asks what it shows. What is the honest answer?
figures.ask_zh: 評審指著這張膠問它顯示了什麼。誠實的回答是什麼？
figures.a_en: This is the MoClo 2.0 Level 1 screen as it reached us, from the 21 September writing document. It arrived with no lane map, no date and no expected sizes, so it can be shown but it cannot be read. The bands sit at one height across almost every lane, which is the pattern our own learn step describes as suspect. We keep it on the page as a record and we do not draw a conclusion from it.
figures.a_zh: 這是 MoClo 2.0 Level 1 的篩選膠，來自 9 月 21 日的寫作文件，傳到我們手上時沒有道次對照表、沒有日期、也沒有預期大小，所以它可以被展示，但沒辦法被判讀。幾乎每一道的帶都落在同一個高度，這正是我們自己在 learn 步驟裡描述過的可疑樣態。我們把它留在頁面上當作紀錄，但不從它推出任何結論。
figures.q_en: Why does our own wiki say this gel 'can be shown but not read'?
figures.q_zh: 為什麼我們自己的 wiki 說這張膠「可以展示但無法判讀」？
opt_en: It reached us with no lane map, no date and no expected sizes
The image resolution is too low to resolve the bands
The ladder was omitted from the gel entirely
The gel was run at the wrong voltage so the bands smeared
opt_zh: 它傳到我們手上時沒有道次對照表、沒有日期、也沒有預期大小
影像解析度太低，看不清楚條帶
這張膠完全沒有跑階梯標記
電壓跑錯，條帶整個糊掉
figures.trap_en: Defending it. The strongest move is to say plainly what is missing and point at the gels that are readable instead.
figures.trap_zh: 替它辯護。最好的回答是直接講清楚缺了什麼，再把話題帶到那些讀得出來的膠。

figures.ask_en: What is this screen, and did it work?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼篩選？它成功了嗎？
figures.a_en: Twenty-four colonies, L1 to L24, screened for pSTK-EXP1-3P-EEBD-RBS0-Csn:GanA-Gala-L3S2P21 on the EXP forward and Csn reverse primers, with the 1 kb ladder in M. It failed. No lane gives a band at the expected 3535 bp: six lanes show something that runs far below the 3 kb ladder step, and the rest show only low-molecular-weight primer dimer. This is the galactosidase reporter arm, and it is the arm we dropped.
figures.a_zh: 二十四個菌落 L1 到 L24，用 EXP 正向與 Csn 反向引子篩選 pSTK-EXP1-3P-EEBD-RBS0-Csn:GanA-Gala-L3S2P21，M 道是 1 kb 階梯。它失敗了。沒有任何一道出現預期的 3535 bp：有六道看得到東西，但跑得遠低於 3 kb 的階梯刻度，其餘各道只有低分子量的引子二聚體。這是半乳糖苷酶報導基因那一支，也是我們後來放棄的那一支。
figures.q_en: What is the result of this 24-colony screen?
figures.q_zh: 這個 24 菌落篩選的結果是什麼？
opt_en: A failure: no lane reaches the expected 3535 bp, and most show only primer dimer
A success: twenty-four of twenty-four colonies carry the construct
A partial success: six of twenty-four carry the correct band
Inconclusive: the ladder was missing so no size could be assigned
opt_zh: 失敗：沒有任何一道達到預期的 3535 bp，多數只有引子二聚體
成功：二十四個菌落全部帶有該構築
部分成功：二十四個中有六個帶正確條帶
無法判定：因為缺少階梯標記，無法指定大小
figures.trap_en: Counting the six low bands as partial success. They run far below the expected size, which makes them the wrong product, not a weak right one.
figures.trap_zh: 把那六條低帶算成部分成功。它們跑得遠低於預期大小，那是錯的產物，不是弱的正確產物。

figures.ask_en: What decision is being argued on this board, and which half did you follow?
figures.ask_zh: 這塊白板上在爭論什麼決定？你們最後走的是哪一半？
figures.a_en: 11 June 2026, the two assembly strategies as they were argued. Strategy 1, across the middle, is a MoClo-to-SubtiToolKit linker. Strategy 2, below it, is the kit's own basic-part syntax, with the 1A to 1D transcription-unit overhangs listed on the right. The build follows the lower half of this board, the kit's own syntax, which is why our parts carry STK overhangs rather than linker-adapted MoClo ones.
figures.a_zh: 2026 年 6 月 11 日，當時被拿出來爭論的兩種組裝策略。策略 1 在白板中間，是 MoClo 轉接到 SubtiToolKit 的連接子方案。策略 2 在下半部，是直接用套件本身的基本零件語法，右邊列出 1A 到 1D 轉錄單元的黏端。我們實際的建構走的是這塊白板的下半部，也就是套件本身的語法——這就是為什麼我們的零件帶的是 STK 黏端，而不是加了連接子的 MoClo 黏端。
kw_zh: MoClo 連接子對 STK 語法
figures.q_en: Which strategy did the build actually follow?
figures.q_zh: 實際的建構最後採用了哪一個策略？
opt_en: Strategy 2, the SubtiToolKit's own basic-part syntax with 1A to 1D overhangs
Strategy 1, a MoClo-to-SubtiToolKit linker
Neither; the team switched to Gibson assembly instead
Both in parallel, one for each protectant
opt_zh: 策略 2，SubtiToolKit 自己的基本零件語法，使用 1A 到 1D 黏端
策略 1，MoClo 轉接 SubtiToolKit 的連接子方案
兩個都沒有；團隊改用 Gibson 組裝
兩個並行，各用於一種保護劑
figures.trap_en: Describing the project as a MoClo build. The overhang syntax is the SubtiToolKit's; MoClo is the thing we decided against on this board.
figures.trap_zh: 把這個專題說成 MoClo 建構。黏端語法用的是 SubtiToolKit 的；MoClo 正是在這塊白板上被否決的那一個。

figures.ask_en: What is this diagram, and what are the sites hidden in the tails for?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼圖？藏在引子尾巴裡的那些切位是做什麼用的？
figures.a_en: An amplicon map of CcaR, 760 bp, with primer 1 covering bases 1 to 50 and primer 2 covering 711 to 760. Each primer tail carries a BbsI site and a BsaI site. That is the Golden Gate grammar: BbsI cuts at the Level 0 step and BsaI at the Level 1 step, so one amplicon can be used twice without re-ordering primers, and the scar-free overhangs are designed in from the start.
figures.a_zh: 這是 CcaR 的擴增片段圖，全長 760 bp，引子 1 涵蓋第 1 到 50 鹼基，引子 2 涵蓋第 711 到 760 鹼基。兩條引子的尾巴裡各藏了一個 BbsI 切位與一個 BsaI 切位。這就是 Golden Gate 的文法：BbsI 在 Level 0 這一步切，BsaI 在 Level 1 這一步切，所以同一段擴增產物不必重新訂引子就能用兩次，無疤痕的黏端一開始就設計進去了。
kw_en: BbsI and BsaI in the tails
kw_zh: 尾巴裡的 BbsI 與 BsaI
兩個 Golden Gate 階層
figures.q_en: Why does each primer tail carry both a BbsI and a BsaI site?
figures.q_zh: 為什麼每條引子的尾巴裡同時有 BbsI 與 BsaI 切位？
opt_en: So one amplicon serves both Golden Gate levels: BbsI at Level 0 and BsaI at Level 1
So the fragment can be screened by two different restriction digests
So the primers can anneal at two different temperatures
So the part can be cloned into either E. coli or B. subtilis vectors
opt_zh: 讓同一段擴增產物可以用在兩個 Golden Gate 階層：Level 0 用 BbsI，Level 1 用 BsaI
讓片段可以用兩種不同的限制酶切來檢查
讓引子可以在兩種不同溫度下黏合
讓這個零件可以選擇接進大腸桿菌或枯草桿菌載體
figures.trap_en: Calling them screening sites. They are assembly sites: the whole point of Golden Gate is that the enzyme cuts outside its own recognition sequence.
figures.trap_zh: 把它們說成檢查用的切位。它們是組裝用的：Golden Gate 的重點就是酵素切在自己辨識序列之外。

figures.ask_en: What is on this plate, and why does the dilution matter?
figures.ask_zh: 這個培養皿上是什麼？稀釋倍數為什麼重要？
figures.a_en: pSTK-EXP2-CcaSRv1-AcdS 2.1 on LB agar at a 1 to 2,000,000 dilution. This is the assembled 10 kb light circuit recovered in B. subtilis WB800. The dilution matters because the plate is still crowded with several hundred colonies at two million fold: that is what makes it an efficiency claim and not just a 'it transformed' photo.
figures.a_zh: LB 洋菜上長的是 pSTK-EXP2-CcaSRv1-AcdS 2.1，稀釋倍數是一比兩百萬。這是組裝完成的 10 kb 光控線路在 B. subtilis WB800 中被回收到的證據。稀釋倍數之所以重要，是因為在兩百萬倍稀釋下這盤還是密密麻麻幾百個菌落：這才讓它成為一個效率的說法，而不只是一張「有轉形到」的照片。
kw_zh: 10 kb 光控線路進入 WB800
figures.q_en: What makes this plate worth showing a judge?
figures.q_zh: 這個培養皿值得拿給評審看的原因是什麼？
opt_en: A 10 kb construct recovered in WB800 with hundreds of colonies still visible at a 1:2,000,000 dilution
It is the shell-side sterility test after a 24 hour run
It compares two electroporation voltages on the same construct
It shows the colour change produced by the AmilCP reporter
opt_zh: 10 kb 的構築在 WB800 中被回收，而且在一比兩百萬稀釋下仍有數百個菌落
這是跑了 24 小時之後的殼側無菌測試
它比較同一構築的兩種電穿孔電壓
它顯示 AmilCP 報導基因產生的顏色變化
figures.trap_en: Showing a crowded plate without its dilution. Without the dilution factor the picture carries no information about efficiency at all.
figures.trap_zh: 拿一盤滿滿的菌落卻不講稀釋倍數。沒有稀釋倍數，這張照片對效率完全沒有任何資訊量。

figures.ask_en: What is collected in these six panels?
figures.ask_zh: 這六個子圖收錄的是什麼？
figures.a_en: The whole output library on one plate: six expression cassettes across the three protectants. A is Csn-AcdS-Histag, one clone at 7762 bp. B is SamyQ-AcdS 2.1-Histag, eight colonies at 1904 bp. C is Csn-LEA14-Histag, one clone at 735 bp. D is SamyQ-LEA14 2.1-Histag, lanes 1 and 4 at 1423 bp. E and F are the two BoPep4 versions, 2.1 and 2.2, with F at 309 bp. Note the honest footnote: the writing document gives 1984 and 7767 where the plate itself is labelled 1904 and 7762, and we carry the plate's own labels.
figures.a_zh: 這是把整個輸出端的構築庫放在一張圖上：三種保護劑、六個表現匣。A 是 Csn-AcdS-Histag，一個選殖株，7762 bp。B 是 SamyQ-AcdS 2.1-Histag，八個菌落，1904 bp。C 是 Csn-LEA14-Histag，一個選殖株，735 bp。D 是 SamyQ-LEA14 2.1-Histag，第 1 與第 4 道，1423 bp。E 與 F 是 BoPep4 的 2.1 與 2.2 兩版，F 在 309 bp。要注意我們自己加的誠實註腳：寫作文件寫的是 1984 與 7767，而膠上標的是 1904 與 7762，我們以膠上的標示為準。
kw_en: A to F with their sizes
kw_zh: 六個表現匣、三種保護劑
A 到 F 各有大小
figures.q_en: What do the six panels A to F represent?
figures.q_zh: A 到 F 這六個子圖代表什麼？
opt_en: Six expression cassettes across the three protectants, each screened by colony PCR
Six time points of one bioreactor run
Six light conditions tested on the LPA
Six salt concentrations tested on Arabidopsis
opt_zh: 橫跨三種保護劑的六個表現匣，每一個都做了菌落 PCR 篩選
一次反應器實驗的六個時間點
在 LPA 上測試的六種光照條件
在阿拉伯芥上測試的六種鹽濃度
figures.trap_en: Missing the size discrepancy. Our own page flags that the writing document and the gel disagree; saying so first is stronger than being caught.
figures.trap_zh: 漏掉大小不一致那件事。我們自己的頁面已經標出寫作文件與膠上的數字不同；主動講比被抓到好。

figures.ask_en: Which module is this, and which lane failed?
figures.ask_zh: 這是哪一個模組？哪一道失敗了？
figures.a_en: 30 July 2026, the rebuilt chromophore module PtagC-RBS-Ho1:pcyA-L3S2P21, twelve colonies A1 to A12 screened at 1833 bp on the BioBrick prefix and STK-seq reverse primers. A11 is the one failure, carrying only a low smear. A1, A2 and A3 sequenced positive the next day. The chromophore module is what makes the phycocyanobilin that CcaS needs, so without it the light circuit cannot sense anything.
figures.a_zh: 2026 年 7 月 30 日，重建的發色團模組 PtagC-RBS-Ho1:pcyA-L3S2P21，十二個菌落 A1 到 A12，用 BioBrick prefix 與 STK-seq 反向引子篩選，預期 1833 bp。A11 是唯一失敗的一道，只有一條低的拖尾。A1、A2、A3 隔天定序確認正確。發色團模組負責做出 CcaS 需要的藻藍膽素，沒有它整條光控線路就什麼都感測不到。
figures.q_en: What does this chromophore module do in the circuit?
figures.q_zh: 這個發色團模組在整條線路裡的作用是什麼？
opt_en: It makes the phycocyanobilin that the CcaS light sensor needs in order to respond to light
It is the output cassette that secretes the protectant
It is the transcriptional regulator that binds the output promoter
It is the terminator that stops read-through into the vector
opt_zh: 它製造 CcaS 光感測器要能對光反應所需要的藻藍膽素（PCB）
它是分泌保護劑的輸出匣
它是結合輸出啟動子的轉錄調控因子
它是防止轉錄讀穿進載體的終止子
figures.trap_en: Forgetting that B. subtilis does not make PCB on its own. Without this module, CcaS is blind.
figures.trap_zh: 忘了 B. subtilis 自己做不出 PCB。沒有這個模組，CcaS 是瞎的。
